description: Clear the company's saved AI appearance and restore normal defaults for future generations. Existing emails stay unchanged. Requires emails:write. Get and review the current style first; a conflict must not be retried automatically.

companyId.description: Company ID; defaults to the selected company.

name: clear_email_ai_style

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `clear_email_ai_style` MCP tool.

canManage.description: Whether this caller can save or clear a style.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

revisionId.description: Observed snapshot revision for conditional save/clear; may be nonnull for an unsupported style version.

style.description: Saved appearance snapshot, or null when none is active.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
